title: Savage, Flair & Elizabeth’s betrayal
summary: Savage and Flair trade the WCW championship while Elizabeth’s return makes their rivalry personal. Her decision to side with Flair turns a title chase into another betrayal of Savage’s trust.

chapters.title: Savage regains the world title
chapters.result: Savage defeats Flair for the championship.
chapters.context: Anderson’s attempted interference backfires, briefly putting Savage back on top.

chapters.title: Elizabeth helps Flair win
chapters.result: Flair defeats Savage in a cage after Elizabeth supplies her shoe.
chapters.context: Elizabeth’s turn gives Flair the title and supplies a personal wound beyond the championship loss.
